scope.summary: Implement automatic joint re-derivation from mesh landmarks per Section 13.18 (BK-18.2, TAI-BK-061), closing REQ-017: joint centers, endpoints, and orientations re-derive from landmark rules (landmark_rules_json) on EVERY channel change, interpolated continuously with channel values — the continuous, zero-manual-step equivalent of Daz's 'Adjust Rigging to Shape + ERC Freeze'; a body whose skeleton is stale relative to its channel state must not pass mesh-stage validation.
acceptance_criteria: LandmarkRules map each joint to a rule over mesh landmark vertex sets (e.g. centroid of a ring, midpoint between rings); rederive_joints(&evaluated_mesh, &rules) produces joint centers/endpoints/orientations for the full canonical skeleton.

Continuity: re-derivation is evaluated per channel change and interpolates continuously — a sweep of shoulder_frame_width across 20 samples produces monotonic, jump-free clavicle joint positions (max inter-sample jump bounded).
The channel-change pipeline (TAI-BK-056 ordering) invokes re-derivation mechanically; TailorBodySkeletonRederived is registered in the tailor.body family and emitted batched per edit transaction.
Staleness gate: a body evaluated with channel state newer than its derived skeleton fails mesh-stage validation with a typed StaleSkeleton finding.
Extreme-channel proof: leg_length max + hand_scale min re-derives knee/ankle/knuckle joints inside their mesh regions (joint-inside-region assertion), with no manual adjust step invoked anywhere.
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz requires manual Adjust-Rigging-to-Shape + ERC Freeze per morph, and skipping it leaves bones floating outside reshaped limbs; without automatic continuous re-derivation, every extreme-proportion body (petite, long legs, small hands) poses with dislocated joints.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
